summary.text: Jovan Jackson is a Democratic member of the Nevada State Assembly who has represented District 6 since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists his profession as entrepreneur.

paragraphs.text: Jovan Jackson was born in Las Vegas, Nevada, earned an associate degree from the College of Southern Nevada in 2019, and attended UNLV; his career experience includes working as an entrepreneur.
Ballotpedia lists affiliations including PLAN, MASS LIB, Faith in Action, Silver State Voices and North Las Vegas Dems.
He assumed office on November 6, 2024, succeeding Shondra Summers-Armstrong.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Government Affairs, Health and Human Services, and Natural Resources committees.
His opponent in the 2026 general election is Katie Duncan, who has no political party.
